## Vocabulary Matching (9 points)
For each definition, select the correct word or phrase. Each correct match is worth 1 point.
**3.** Select the word or phrase for each definition. (3 points)
Write the letter of the matching option.
| 1. an untrue claim made to deceive someone | ____ | A. circumstance |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 2. another person, whether a friend or a stranger | ____ | B. false pretense |
| 3. a condition surrounding a particular event | ____ | C. fellow man |
Correct answer: <i>1–B, 2–C, 3–A</i>
